# EXECUTION PROMPT — Fix license-plate/GS1 scan URLs: subdomain error, mobile/desktop resolution, DB-backed redirect

> Generated for target repo `cycleforge-app` from goal: *[LINEAR CYC-64] Fix license-plate/GS1 scan URLs: subdomain error, mobile/desktop resolution, DB-backed redirect

Scanning a license-plate (LPN / handling-unit) label must resolve to the box page. The printed label's DataMatrix carries the bare `H-{id}` handle and `routeScan()` already routes that to `/m/h/{id}` (the page exists: `src/app/m/(shell)/h/[id]/page.tsx`). But the URL form of the same identity — `https://…/m/h/12` or the bare path `/m/h/12` — is unroutable and falls through to the letter→bin fallback with no redirect. All edits are in ONE file: `src/lib/barcode-routing.ts`.

Current code, line 39:

```
const MOBILE_PATH_RE = /\/m\/(r|l|u)\/([^/?#\s]+)/i;
```

Current code, line 85:

```
const FLATTENED_MOBILE_LINK_RE = /^https?.*m([rlu])(\d+)$/i;
```

Current code, lines 97–98 (inside the switch in pathToRoute):

```
 case 'u':
 return { type: 'serial-unit', value, redirect: `/m/u/${id}` };
```

The change, in words: (1) add the letter h to the alternation group in the regex on line 39; (2) add the letter h to the character class in the regex on line 85; (3) after the 'u' case at lines 97–98, add a matching 'h' case that returns type 'handling-unit' with redirect path `/m/h/` plus the id. The 'handling-unit' member already exists in the ScanType union at line 24, and the bare-handle branch at line 246 already emits the identical route shape.

Work required: three bounded edits in `src/lib/barcode-routing.ts` (lines 39, 85, and after 98). Verify with `npm run verify:fast`. Acceptance: routeScan('/m/h/12') and routeScan('[https://usav.app.cycleforge.ai/m/h/12](<https://usav.app.cycleforge.ai/m/h/12>)') both return type 'handling-unit' with redirect '/m/h/12'.
